glossary.title: Fuel Price Adjustment
glossary.meaning: A monthly charge when the price of fuel used to make electricity changes. It applies to everyone in the country, and is sometimes negative.

glossary.title: Quarterly Adjustment
glossary.meaning: Every three months the government raises or lowers electricity rates. That change appears on this line.

glossary.title: General Sales Tax
glossary.meaning: Federal government tax on the cost of electricity.

glossary.title: Electricity Duty
glossary.meaning: A provincial tax. It was removed from electricity bills from July 2025, so newer bills should not have it.

glossary.title: Fixed Charges
glossary.meaning: Since February 2026, a monthly charge for each kilowatt (kW) of your sanctioned load, even if you use little electricity. Lifeline homes do not pay it.

glossary.title: Arrears
glossary.meaning: Unpaid amount from earlier bills. If you already paid, show your receipt to get it removed.

glossary.title: Late Payment Surcharge
glossary.meaning: A penalty added if you pay after the due date. Pay on time to avoid it.

glossary.title: TV Fee
glossary.meaning: The Rs 35 PTV fee was removed from electricity bills in July 2025. If a new bill still shows it, ask your electricity company.
